resources.string: No intervention decisions yet. Zero data is not a perfect score.
Pattern sample is large enough for a quiet observation, not a causal claim.
What did you make it mean?

Research-supported: implementation intentions and self-monitoring can support behavior change. Evidence-informed: Prottasha’s Step Back and rebound summaries combine those ideas with local event data. Book-inspired: identity language draws from Atomic Habits; self-image reflection draws from Psycho-Cybernetics. Prottasha does not diagnose, treat, or prove reclaimed time. Rapid reopen is not counted as durable follow-through.
